topic: Whether every marked-content tag must be interpreted as a logical-structure role
decision: No. EC3 #334 deletes the base NOTE 3 stating the lack of relationship to Tagged PDF and replaces the discussion with second-class-name guidance for tags undefined by ISO publications or §14.7. The producer's tag naming/structure relationship does not impose a reader duty to treat arbitrary content-stream tags as structure-tree role mappings. The logical-structure consumer has its own §14.7 rows.

topic: Whether readers must reject improper nesting, misplaced marked operators, or inline indirect references
decision: No mandatory reject behavior identified. The marked-content nesting, operator placement, tag/property requirements, and direct-only inline form are producer constraints. EC3 #335 changes valid placement contexts; #302 extends valid balancing pairs. Keep robustness diagnostics and invalid-input handling separate from these valid-input reader assertions.

topic: Whether to draft additional MP/DP or placement regression tests
decision: No additional draft in this shard. MP/DP points have no general drawing effect; the observable DP optional-content reference behavior is covered by optional_content.rs::a_group_named_only_by_a_marked_content_point_is_still_referenced. Existing tests cover the public reader obligation for page Contents-array sequence continuity, named and inline property-list consumption, and nested matching boundaries for /Tx splicing.
